name: Liquid Nitrogen
storageAndHandling: Supplied in cryocans (customer's or our own). Handle with cryogenic gloves and eye protection. Store in well-ventilated area.

seo.title: Liquid Nitrogen Supplier | Sunrise Gases
seo.description: Liquid nitrogen supplied in cryocans for cryogenic preservation, industrial freezing, and laboratory applications. Supplied from Nagpur.

faq.question: Can I get my own cryocan refilled?
faq.answer: Yes. We refill customer-owned cryocans with liquid nitrogen.

faq.question: Do you supply cryocans too?
faq.answer: Yes. Sunrise Gases' own cryocans are available for rent or purchase, in 11L, 26L, 35L, and 50L sizes.

faq.question: What is liquid nitrogen used for?
faq.answer: Cryogenic preservation, industrial freezing, medical and laboratory work, and metal treatment. Liquid nitrogen boils at −196°C.
